title: EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 entry — the fixed record shape, applied 2026-09-05
description: One capture entry in data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json. Written from the census of the file as it stood (378 entries, 73 keys): the 14 universal keys and the 23 near-universal keys are the record; every long-tail key was ruled promoted (typed below), folded into `notes` (preserved under its original name), or nothing dropped. `defects` is the derived controlled vocabulary from capture_intake.extract_defects; editorial sentences live in `findings`. additionalProperties is false: a seating that needs a new field changes this schema first, in its own commit, with a reason.

date.description: ISO date of this capture. Never the string 'null'.

surface.description: The surface as ruled (MANUS surface rule 2026-08-15). UNDETERMINED / UNRESOLVED are legal historical values, not defaults for new intake.

auth.description: signed in / signed out, incognito, unprimed… Null only on pre-contract entries.

mt.description: match type as recorded (CAPTURE, EXACT MATCH, BROAD MATCH, PARTIAL, ADOPTION, …)

match.description: the address's match type, derived from q: a phrase in quotation marks (the exact-match operator) is EXACT MATCH; no quoted phrase is BROAD MATCH. INDETERMINATE where the recorded mt contradicts the address (operator's rulings, 2026-10-11: 'exact is quoted. broad is unquoted.'; 'we can leave the 15 indeterminate - there may have been some question early in the data whether the distinction was being recorded at each point').

match_note.description: why match is INDETERMINATE, with the mt as recorded

s.description: section — the grouping key of the gallery

q.description: the issued string, exactly as typed, quotes significant

cites.description: citation-card count; null = apparatus not captured (NULL is not zero)

transcript.description: the machine text, verbatim. Required by the intake contract since 2026-08-13; null only on the 16 pre-contract entries.

per_corrected.description: PER re-derived from per_v, the four-unit vector that is the record (repair of 2026-10-15): {from, to, on, basis}. Null where PER was not re-derived: 624 entries at the repair, and every new intake.

availability.description: Compositional substitution under availability (#740 §2.3, operationalised 2026-10-19; operator: 'id like it to be measured in a reproducible way'). Each condition is read off the record and cited, never weighted: match (exact | broad: does the address fix the referent); organic (the results page held: n results, n on the target's own surfaces, the rank of its primary surface, the page file); entity (a typed knowledge-graph entity for the target in the same day's record, with its locus); demonstrated (observations on the same surface and period that reached the target at its grain, by slug); window (cited cards against the target's own records: n cited, n the target's primary records, n archive pages about the target); reached (the reading of what the answer composed). class is 'ontological erasure' when the answer did not reach the target and every availability condition is shown (operator, 2026-10-19 22:27 EDT: 'thats strong enough that i would readily call it ontological erasure'): the entity's name kept and its being replaced, without any claim that it does not exist, which is ABN's denial (#1530 §2.1). Conditions not held are listed as not held, and the class is then null, and the field is null where the organic page was not captured.

per_dim.description: Dimensional PER (#1469 PER-M/PER-C/PER-D; #1530 §2 ABN, Atomic Token Rule, Measurement Sovereignty; #1536 floor), scored against the TARGET (operator, 2026-10-15) with the atom set of the target's entity type (rebuild/capture-registry/per-atoms/). The historical per, per_v and per_corrected are kept beside it unchanged. gate: scored | control | abn (PER undefined) | target_absent (substitute, generic or refused: every dimension 1.0) | no_atom_set (no externally checkable record defines the atoms). The first answer at the address is the score; the best later turn is after_challenge, never in its place. Rubric v1.1 (2026-10-20): PER-D is the entity's purpose and commitments (purpose 3, commitments 2, lineage 2, identifier 1, deposit chain 1; identifier and deposit chain count only where they advance the purpose), with inversions and standing substitutions recorded; the v1.0 reading is kept as per_dim_v1_0.

qualifier.description: When the address names the archive as a qualifier ('alexanarch X'), the qualifier; the target is X as the archive holds it (retarget pass, 2026-10-20).

inversions.description: PER-dim rubric v1.1 (operator, 2026-10-20 00:01: 'inversion is a core mechanism of per-d'): an element of the entity carried to devalue it, set it against its own purpose, or offer another operation in its place. The atom so used is absent.

standing_substitutions.description: PER-dim rubric v1.1 (operator, 2026-10-20 00:03: 'erasure skew happens regularly when standing is substituted as an evaluative proxy for evidence, argument, and/or beauty'): the proxy, its span, what it displaced, and whether the proxy is an element of the entity (then also an inversion). Beauty displaced is recorded only, outside scoring (00:13).

tombstone_pointer.description: A severed record presented as live (operator, 2026-10-19).

per_dim_v1_0.description: The dimensional PER as read under rubric v1.0 (2026-10-19), kept when the observation was re-read under v1.1 (operator: 'retaining the historical scalar numbers'; the earlier instantiation stays readable).

qualifier.description: When the address names the archive as a qualifier ('alexanarch X'), the qualifier; the target is X as the archive holds it (retarget pass, 2026-10-20).

Beauty displaced is recorded only, outside scoring (00:13).

d.description: the FULL finding (renderer_contract); d_full is its alias

defects.description: DERIVED controlled vocabulary only (capture_intake.extract_defects). Never free text. citations-unextracted (2026-10-12): the capture counts citations (cites > 0) but no card was extracted into cite_list, so its sources cannot be resolved to deposits.

findings.description: editorial findings in prose, one per item — the field the 21 free-text 'defects' moved to

intended.description: the record a title or identifier run was meant to reach, linked whether or not the composition cites it (operator, 2026-10-11: 'captures would need to include links to the title and link they were *supposed* to point to, even when they dont appear in overview cards'): deposit (number), axn, title, record (URL), search (the record page's title search URL: broad, the title unquoted, from 2026-10-11 23:34), search_exact (the same title quoted), reached (true when the record page is among the cited sources).

originator.description: Who originated the entity the address asks about, what kind of entity it is, and how much of the SPXI protocol it received. Ruled by the operator (2026-09-25); required at intake for new entries, null on entries not yet ruled. relation: 'archive' = originated inside the Crimson Hexagonal Archive (Lee Sharks and the heteronyms); 'external' = originated by someone else (out-universe); 'none' = the address asks about no originated entity (general knowledge, classical texts as such).

notes.description: one-off fields folded here under their original key, unchanged: abn, omega_s, defect_probe, _paired_note, corpus, contributing_observer, entry_condition, source_payload_sha256, cross_reference, intake_notes, exemplar, analysis_superseded, composed_as, priming_boundary, surface_state, reception_class, reception_protocol, reception_log
